in_marathi.name: Devvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is descended from the gods. It is derived from the two words ‘Dev’ meaning god and ‘Vansh’ meaning descendant.

in_bengali.name: Devvansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's descendant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devvansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is descended from the gods. It is derived from the two words ‘Dev’ meaning god and ‘Vansh’ meaning descendant.
